name: minimax-h3-max

metadata.comment: V2 async task API, fast tier. Pay-as-you-go list price $0.05/s at 480P and $0.08/s at 768P; no 2K. Plus $0.074 per input image beyond the first 2. Audio input is free. Reference video input is rejected, since MiniMax bills its duration only after the create call.

sources.label: LiteLLM pinned native-namespace record [minimax/MiniMax-H3-Max]; code evidence, not official API attestation
MiniMax official H3 generation family and multimodal input; pricing depends on resolution/media and is not flattened to per-token chat price
